tactics: intro β α inst b f l
intros β α inst b f l; induction l <;> simp_all [List.count_cons, List.countP_cons] <;> split <;> simp_all

intro β α inst b f l
induction l with
| nil => rfl
| cons x xs ih => cases h : f x <;> simp_all [List.filterMap_cons, List.count_cons, List.countP_cons]
intro β α inst b f l; induction l <;> simp [List.filterMap_cons, List.count_cons, List.countP_cons, *] <;> split <;> simp_all <;> rfl
